title: Peninsula Summer Music Festival 2027, Save the Date
summary: Peninsula Summer Music Festival returns 2 to 11 January 2027. Program and tickets TBC. 2026 edition spanned 18 events at wineries, churches and outdoor venues.
priceRange: TBC, 2026 tickets ranged approx $30 to $80+ per event
suitableFor: Classical/jazz/contemporary music lovers; wine and culture visitors; couples
accessibilityNotes: Venues vary, some outdoor, some historic churches; PSMF accommodates accessibility needs on request
nearbyAttractions: Mornington Peninsula wineries; Peninsula Hot Springs; Flinders village
suggestedItineraryPairing: Multi-day festival stay; pair with cellar door visits and Peninsula Hot Springs
editorVerdict: Save-the-date for the festival that puts world-class chamber music inside a winery. Tickets release expected October 2026.
editorNote:
The Peninsula Summer Music Festival has confirmed 2 to 11 January 2027 on its official site. Program, artists, venues and ticketing not yet released; based on the 2026 pattern, expect on-sale around October 2026.

The 2026 edition ran 18 events across Flinders Civic Hall, Montalto, Port Phillip Estate, Peninsula Hot Springs and St John's Anglican Flinders, with classical at the centre and jazz and contemporary on the flanks (The Bamboos, Karin Schaupp, Ensemble Offspring, AYO Young Artists, Ensemble 642). Tickets ranged roughly $30 to $80 per event.

If you're a returning attendee, get on the festival mailing list now. If new, watch for the program drop and a multi-event pass.
kidsGradeNote: A family concert is typically programmed; the rest of the festival is adult-classical and ticketed.
